qualifier: membrane-tethered FGFR and PDGFR fusions plus ALK/LTK
name: Membrane-tethered oncogenic FGFR, PDGFR and ALK/LTK kinase signalling
rationale: All members are constitutive signalling by cancer-altered receptor tyrosine kinases at the plasma membrane (FGFR1/2/3 and PDGFR fusions, ALK and LTK), distinguishing them from cytosolic fusions, FLT3, and EGFR/ERBB2 or amplification mutants in the confusables.

name: RUNX1-directed myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocyte lineage differentiation
rationale: Members cover granulocyte, monocyte, mast cell, erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation and their RUNX1/RUNX2/RUNX3 transcriptional control, whereas confusables centre on stem cell homeostasis, erythrocyte maturation or non-haematopoietic RUNX1 targets.

name: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase burst and anti-inflammatory macrophage signalling
rationale: Members combine NADPH oxidase superoxide generation in phagocytes with anti-inflammatory macrophage responses (CD163, FCGR3A-IL10, ADORA2B, leishmania damping), while confusables are neutrophil chemotaxis/degranulation, ROS catabolism or dendritic cell antigen presentation.

qualifier: adherens, desmosomal and hemidesmosomal with apicobasal polarity
name: Epithelial adherens, desmosomal and hemidesmosomal junctions with apicobasal polarity
rationale: Members are cadherin adherens junction assembly and turnover, desmosomes, hemidesmosomes, intermediate filaments and apical/basal polarity, which the confusables (cadherin regulation, EMT inhibition, endothelial morphogenesis) lack.

name: Renal proximal tubule urate, organic ion and cystine transport
rationale: Members are SLC carriers for urate, organic anions and cations and cystine with their renal hypouricemia and cystinuria defects and proximal tubule development, distinguishing them from the amino acid and peptide transporter confusables.

qualifier: sterol-sensing SREBP control of biosynthesis and uptake
name: Sterol-sensing SREBP control of cholesterol biosynthesis and uptake
rationale: Members concern sensing cellular cholesterol and SREBP-mediated regulation of cholesterol synthesis and receptor-mediated uptake, unlike confusables about LXR-driven efflux, reverse transport or LDL receptor degradation.

qualifier: capping and suppression of recombination and end-joining
name: Telomere capping and protection from recombination and end-joining
rationale: Members are telomere capping, packaging and shelterin localization that block recombination, NHEJ and telomerase access, distinct from confusables on telomerase extension, semi-conservative replication, D-loop/t-circle handling or C-strand synthesis.

name: Endothelial eNOS-nitric oxide-cGMP control of vascular tone
rationale: Members link eNOS activation and trafficking and NO-cGMP signalling to vascular smooth muscle contraction/relaxation and arterial pressure, whereas confusables emphasise generic smooth muscle contraction or renal guanylyl cyclase and sodium excretion.

core: Lipid modification and secretion of morphogens
name: Palmitoylation and secretion of Wnt and Hedgehog morphogens
rationale: Members are N-terminal and cysteine palmitoylation by HHAT/PORCN and the resulting release of Hedgehog and Wnt ligands, unlike confusables on downstream Hh/Wnt signalling, Hh autoprocessing or prenylation.

qualifier: bile acids, bilirubin, sterols and drugs
name: Enterohepatic bile acid, bilirubin, sterol and drug transport
rationale: Members span bile acid synthesis and recycling, bilirubin glucuronidation and export, sterol/vitamin E absorption and SLCO/ABC-mediated drug transport with their hereditary defects, distinguishing them from phase I/II xenobiotic metabolism and lipoprotein assembly confusables.

name: Homologous recombination repair by strand invasion and DNA synthesis
rationale: Members are recombinational repair steps (strand invasion, SDSA, sister chromatid exchange, repair synthesis, cross-link repair) rather than the NHEJ, damage-sensing, break-induced replication or telomere processes of the confusables.

qualifier: iron sequestration and endolysosomal peptide-histidine transport
name: Phagocyte iron sequestration and endolysosomal peptide-histidine transport
rationale: Members combine iron and heme acquisition at the host-pathogen interface, neutrophil antimicrobial granule programmes and proton/oligopeptide-histidine transporters, unlike confusables on systemic transferrin, heme scavenging and erythrocyte gas transport.

qualifier: end replication, capping and recombination suppression
name: Telomere end replication, capping and recombination suppression
rationale: Members cover telomere C-strand synthesis and semi-conservative replication together with capping, D-loop/t-circle control and recombination inhibition, distinguishing them from telomerase extension, break-induced replication and general DNA topology confusables.

name: Enterohepatic bile acid recycling, signalling and feedback control
rationale: Members are bile acid transport, recycling, receptor signalling and feedback regulation of synthesis, whereas confusables are the cholesterol-to-bile-acid synthesis routes or intestinal lipid absorption and lipoprotein assembly.

qualifier: induced by growth factors and inflammatory signals
name: AP-1 immediate-early gene induction by growth factors and inflammation
rationale: Members are AP-1/FOS-JUN target and activation programmes, NR4A growth-factor-induced genes and TNF/NF-kB and KRAS response signatures in monocytes and fibroblasts, unlike confusables on UV stress, mRNA decay or MAPK feedback.

name: Neuropeptide control of sleep-wake, feeding and locomotor rhythm
rationale: Members govern REM/non-REM sleep and wakefulness, eating behaviour and locomotor rhythm including orexin/QRFP/NPFF receptor binding, distinguishing them from stress-hormone, social behaviour and appetite-hormone confusables.

qualifier: smooth muscle tone and natriuretic cGMP signalling
name: Smooth muscle tone and natriuretic cGMP in blood pressure
rationale: Members are smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, guanylyl cyclase cGMP synthesis and renal sodium and urine output in arterial pressure control, unlike the eNOS-NO confusables or the renin-angiotensin confusable.

name: 12-lipoxygenase hepoxilin and epidermal barrier fatty acid metabolism
rationale: Members are 12-lipoxygenase/hepoxilin eicosanoid synthesis plus fatty acid and linoleate oxidation tied to ichthyosis genes, distinguishing them from cornification, CYP epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase and 5/15-LOX lipoxin confusables.

name: RNA methylation and pseudouridylation with mitochondrial ribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members are rRNA, tRNA and mRNA methylation and pseudouridylation together with mitochondrial RNA processing, mitoribosome assembly and translation, unlike confusables on tRNA aminoacylation, nuclear tRNA processing or snRNA modification.

name: Nitrogen-starvation autophagy with ATG8 delipidation and nucleophagy
rationale: The three members are nutrient-starvation responses, ATG8/LC3 delipidation and piecemeal nuclear microautophagy, distinguishing them from autophagosome assembly, lysosome fusion and prenylation confusables.

name: Cardiac action potential ion channels and conduction-system pacemaking
rationale: Members span all action potential phases, Kir/Kv/HCN/K2P channels and SA/AV node, His and Purkinje conduction, unlike confusables on gap junction coupling or negative regulation of calcium and action potentials.

name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein lipolysis, clearance and LXR-driven lipogenesis
rationale: Members are chylomicron and VLDL remodelling by LPL/LIPC, their clearance, and LXR control of lipogenesis and triglyceride turnover, distinguishing them from intestinal assembly and HDL/LDL remodelling confusables.

name: Copper and manganese ion transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members are copper import, detoxification and homeostasis, manganese transport and ceruloplasmin deficiency, unlike the iron, zinc, cadmium and metallothionein confusables.

name: Osmotic salt-water homeostasis via vasopressin, aquaporins and cation-chloride cotransporters
rationale: Members cover renal sodium, potassium, chloride, magnesium and water handling, osmotic stress responses, vasopressin-aquaporin signalling and SLC12 cotransporter disorders, distinguishing them from renin-angiotensin, potassium channel and glycerol-aquaporin confusables.

qualifier: axial mesoderm, notochord and floor plate
name: Axial mesoderm, notochord and floor plate ventral midline development
rationale: Members are notochord/axial mesoderm formation, floor plate and ventral midline development and early neural plate patterning, unlike confusables on neural plate border, left-right asymmetry or spinal neuron specification.
